# LAN Screen Cast (局域投屏)

> Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) Android app for screen mirroring and media casting over a local network (same Wi‑Fi), with no internet access, ads, account or data collection. One APK acts as both sender (phones/tablets) and receiver (Android TV, TV boxes, tablets, phones). Status: pre-release; implemented and emulator-tested, not yet verified on real devices.

Key facts:
- Screen mirroring: WebRTC (H.264) with host-only ICE (no STUN/TURN). Playback audio is captured via AudioPlaybackCapture; the microphone is never used. The connection uses mutual TLS 1.3 with certificate pinning, plus SPAKE2 PIN pairing on the first connection.
- Connecting: mDNS/SSDP discovery, QR code, 8-digit cast code, or manual IP.
- Quality presets: Smooth, Balanced, High and Game. Game is 720p60 with a minimal jitter buffer and a low-latency decoder, and can be switched mid-session.
- DLNA/UPnP: works as a media renderer (receiver) for video apps, and as a controller that pushes local video, photos, music or URLs to any DLNA TV. Unsupported videos are transcoded with Media3 Transformer.
- System share sheet: share files or links from any app straight to a TV. Direct Share targets point to recently used TVs.
- Compatible with Apple devices (unofficial): iPhone and iPad can mirror via Screen Mirroring, using UxPlay through JNI. Off by default.
- Also includes: elder mode (large UI, one-tap cast to TVs pinned by a family member), optional reverse control (accessibility service, confirmed every session), a TV remote-friendly UI, and local-only diagnostics.
- Requirements: Android 10+ (minSdk 29). Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Compose for TV, Hilt, Ktor and libwebrtc.
